name: theme-default
title: Byterygon theme: default
description: The Byterygon default theme: a blue-teal brand on a neutral tinted with the same hue, light by default, comfortable density, WCAG 2.2 AA. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.
